mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the temperature and door-opening logs was most worthwhile: it made the spikes more understandable without claiming to establish what stored objects experienced.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequential module assembly and installation were clear but predictable, with little meaningful choice beyond following the repair.

surprise.text: The final service record introduced a renewal warning on the supply controller even after the cabinet held its range.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining the forecast with the monitored cooler was somewhat abstract; I wasn't sure exactly what it would produce.

continue.text: Yes, I'd try another chapter to see how the supply warning is addressed, although the straightforward repair sequence offered limited decisions.
